_comment: Public release-state interface. It carries generic states and no case history: which reviews ran, by whom, and against which internal evidence is deliberately not represented here. A state is PASS only when the corresponding prerequisite is satisfied; the default is PENDING and the interface is fail-closed.

distribution: Zenodo — archival copy of record and citable identifier
releases/1.1/ in this repository — discoverable copy, digest-checked in CI

semantic_review.meaning: Independent review of the model's structure and claims is complete and its findings are resolved or explicitly accepted.

coauthor_approval.meaning: Co-author approval for the release of this exact artifact is on record.

governance_clearance.meaning: All programme prerequisites for release are closed and no hold is active.

founder_release_authorization.meaning: Release of this exact artifact was authorized.

policy.rule: A state may be PASS only when every prerequisite mapped to it is satisfied. The weakest prerequisite determines the public state: no averaging, no partial credit.
policy.evidence_location: Detailed prerequisites, their evidence and their mapping to these four states are held outside this repository and are not part of the public interface.
